footer.tagline: A community guide to water filtration plants in and around Faisalabad. Free to use, no account needed.
footer.plantData: Plant data comes from an imported spreadsheet and is not verified on site.
footer.noAccount: We never show reporters' phone numbers. Your search location is not stored.
footer.attributionUnavailable: attribution unavailable while the service is offline
demo.title: Demonstration data is switched on.
demo.text: Plants labelled DEMO are not real — don't rely on them.
issue.no_coordinates: The source doesn't give this plant's coordinates, so its exact site is unknown.
issue.area_not_geocodable: The recorded area isn't a place name that can be found on a map (for example "Saline Zone" or "Kachi Abadi").
issue.area_name_possible_typo: The area name may contain a typing error (for example "Chalk" for "Chak"). The original is kept.
issue.sector_suffix_unverified: The "Sector" number after the area name isn't a known official subdivision.
issue.operator_type_is_plant_type: The operator field describes a type of plant, not who runs it.
issue.operator_type_technology_mismatch: The operator type and the filtration technology don't match each other.
issue.operator_acronym_unexplained: The operator is given only as an acronym that the source doesn't explain.
issue.capacity_gallon_type_unspecified: The capacity is in gallons, but the source doesn't say whether US or imperial gallons.
issue.capacity_unusually_high: The recorded capacity is unusually high for a community filtration point and needs checking.
issue.status_undated: The operating status has no date, so we can't tell how current it is.
issue.coordinates_out_of_bounds: The recorded coordinates fall outside the Faisalabad area.
issue.coordinates_possibly_swapped: The latitude and longitude may have been entered the wrong way round.
issue.unrecognised_technology: The filtration technology wasn't recognised, so no treatment stages are shown.
field.name: Plant name
issue.duplicate_plant_code: This Plant ID appeared more than once in the source. The extra copy was kept separately for staff review.
issue.geocoded_location_unverified: The location was found from an address and hasn't been verified by staff yet.
issue.geocode_ambiguous: The address matched several different places.
